intro.summary: A nine-day prayer to St. Rocco, asking his intercession for protection from plague and contagious disease and for healing and mercy for the sick.

blocks.text: You can pray the full St Rocco Novena Against Plagues below.
blocks.title: Introduction

blocks.notes: Standardized “St.” to “Saint,” corrected “thou has” to “thou hast,” and made the threefold repetition instruction clearer for speaking.; converted "mention request here" into a personal-intention pause marker; reused compacted prayer source from an earlier section; converted intention marker into sacred bell and personal-intention pause

parts.text: In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen. O Great Saint Rocco, deliver us, we beseech thee, from contagious diseases. Through thy intercession, preserve our bodies from illness, and our souls from the contagion of sin. Obtain for us salubrious air, but, above all, purity of heart. Assist us to make good use of health, to bear suffering with patience, and, after thy example, to live in the practice of penance and charity, that we may one day enjoy the happiness which thou hast merited by thy virtues.
Saint Rocco, pray for us. Repeat three times. In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
